evidence.content_invariant: A prover-aware check (grep for defthm/defun/defrule/define/defsection/encapsulate/in-theory/defaxiom) finds zero declaration forms in any of these files. Every top-level form is either a bare rule-name symbol or a rule-name symbol followed by (fire-count try-count (:rule-class rule-name)) tuples: a rune-usage profiling report the certify-book toolchain writes to `.sys/` after certification, containing no theorem statement, definition, or proof of its own. In books/kestrel/java/language/.sys/grammar@useless-runes.lsp the quote and semicolon characters found by a naive grep belong to pipe-escaped symbol names for Java lexical-grammar terminals (e.g. |CST-"!"-LEAFTERM|), not to string literals or comments; a check for true comment lines (^;) returns 0, confirming the same bare-symbol/tuple format.
evidence.rationale: Remove exact declaration-free ACL2 certify-book useless-runes profiling sidecars from primary formalization search; they are generated build/certification cache output, not authored formal content.
review_evidence: All 4 files individually scanned end to end (full read for the two under 50000 bytes, head/tail sampling plus targeted line-content checks for the two larger ones) with grep -icE for defthm/defun/defrule/define/defsection/encapsulate/in-theory/defaxiom returning 0 in every file, confirming bare-symbol/tuple format with no declaration content.
books/kestrel/java/language/.sys/grammar@useless-runes.lsp: grep -n for lines starting with ';' returned no matches, ruling out comment content despite nonzero raw semicolon/quote character counts.

Every top-level form is either a bare rule-name symbol or a rule-name symbol followed by (fire-count try-count (:rule-class rule-name)) tuples: a rune-usage profiling report the certify-book toolchain writes to `.sys/` after certification, containing no theorem statement, definition, or proof of its own. books/kestrel/rust/syntax/.sys/grammar@useless-runes.lsp contains pipe-escaped symbol names for Rust lexical-grammar terminals (e.g. |CST-"!"-LEAFTERM|, |CST-";"-LEAFTERM|) whose embedded quote and semicolon characters a naive grep flags, but a check for true comment lines (^;) returns 0, confirming the same bare-symbol/tuple format as every other file in this rule, matching the pattern already established for a Java grammar file in an earlier unit.
evidence.rationale: Remove exact declaration-free ACL2 certify-book useless-runes profiling sidecars from primary formalization search; they are generated build/certification cache output, not authored formal content.

Physical content deduplication is deferred until alias paths can themselves participate in retrieval without loss.
